name: word-cascade
title: Word Cascade
description: A paragraph that arrives word by word, each word rising into place after the last.

perf.budget: One linear timing drives every word; each word evaluates a small style worklet per frame until the cascade ends.

a11y.reducedMotion: The whole paragraph appears at once.
a11y.screenReader: Exposed as one text element with the full paragraph; individual words are hidden.
